title: unprotect_request truncates uint64 PIV into uint32 seq defeating replay widening
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_protect.c:298,321,337,388. decode_piv returns uint64_t (40-bit PIV per oscore.h OSCORE_SSN_MAX) but local uint32_t seq feeds replay_reserve_pending_locked/replay_update_window; >2^32 seq numbers commit recipient_seq regressed low-32 bits and bitmap bits at wrong slots; genuine colliding messages get false OSCORE_ERR_REPLAY (availability). End-to-end defeat of oscore_replay.c uint64 widening (worker6-1nou) through its ONLY production caller. Fix: uint64_t seq + PRIu64 logging; audit module-wide casts (protect/response paths verified clean).
close_reason: oscore_protect.c: unprotect_request seq changed uint32_t->uint64_t so decode_piv() 40-bit PIV flows full-width into replay_reserve_pending_locked/replay_clear_pending_locked/replay_update_window and the nvm_failed seq+1 rollback compare. All three seq log sites unified to %" PRIu64 " (inttypes.h include; matches sibling SSN logs in oscore_ctx.c). Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra OK both files; grep audit shows zero uint32_t seq locals/casts or %u seq formats left in oscore module (apps/gateway seq types are unrelated subsystems).
